title: booking
description: Book Wanaka Haus, an Architectural Passive home in Wānaka NZ. Availability, quotes, Stripe checkout.
summary: Book Wanaka Haus, an Architectural Passive home in Wānaka NZ. Availability, quotes, Stripe checkout.
offersHint: Book Wanaka Haus, an Architectural Passive home in Wānaka NZ. Availability, quotes, Stripe checkout. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://wanakahaus.nz/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_availability
toolsPreview.description: Open and booked nights for Wanaka Haus (sleeps 8, Wānaka NZ) in a date window, up to 18 months ahead. Ranges are check-in inclusive, check-out exclusive.

toolsPreview.name: get_quote
toolsPreview.description: Itemised NZD total for a stay at Wanaka Haus. Validates the stay rules (minimum nights, peak-season minimum, guest cap) and checks the dates are open, before you commit to a booking.

toolsPreview.name: create_booking
toolsPreview.description: Book Wanaka Haus: atomically holds the dates for 30 minutes and returns a Stripe Checkout URL. The booking confirms only when payment completes on that URL — give it to your user to pay (or pay with an agent wallet's one-time card). No account or API key needed.

toolsPreview.name: get_booking
toolsPreview.description: Status of a Wanaka Haus booking: held, confirmed, cancelled or lapsed.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_booking
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a Wanaka Haus booking under the published policy (full refund to 14 days before arrival, 50% to 7 days, none inside 7). Requires the guest email the booking was made with.
